listing.name: Shadow of Rome / Korvonordico PS2Recomp
listing.summary: Unofficial PC port of Shadow of Rome (PS2), statically recompiled with PS2Recomp. Drawn by the video card with PCSX2's GS, VU1 by PCSX2's microVU: smooth 60 FPS, up to 8x, 16:9 and 21:9, wider field of view, a cleaner picture without blur and grain. The whole game played to the end. Discs: European (5 languages), its Russian translation, American.
